connections:
  "shopper-to-gateway" "shopper" -> "gateway" sync "HTTPS" carriedTypes=["OrderRequest"]
  "gateway-to-orders" "gateway" -> "orders" sync "POST /orders" carriedTypes=["OrderRequest"]
  "orders-to-order-db" "orders" -> "order-db" sync "Commit order + outbox" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced","OrderUpdated"]
  "orders-to-order-events" "orders" -> "order-events" async "OrderPlaced" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced"]
  "order-events-to-inventory" "order-events" -> "inventory" async "Reserve inventory" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced"]
  "order-events-to-payments" "order-events" -> "payments" async "Authorize payment" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced"]
  "order-events-to-notifications" "order-events" -> "notifications" async "Send confirmation" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced"]
  "inventory-to-stock-db" "inventory" -> "stock-db" sync "Reserve SKUs" carriedTypes=["InventoryReserved"]
  "payments-to-payment-db" "payments" -> "payment-db" sync "Record authorization" carriedTypes=["PaymentCompleted"]
  "notifications-to-notify-cache" "notifications" -> "notify-cache" sync "SET NX · dedupe" carriedTypes=["NotificationRequested"]
  "payments-to-payment-events" "payments" -> "payment-events" async "PaymentCompleted" carriedTypes=["PaymentCompleted"]
  "payment-events-to-orders" "payment-events" -> "orders" async "group: orders-payments" carriedTypes=["PaymentCompleted"]
  "orders-to-schemas" "orders" -> "schemas" sync "Fetch Avro schema" carriedTypes=["OrderPlaced"]
  "metrics-to-orders" "metrics" -> "orders" sync "GET /metrics" carriedTypes=[]
  "dashboard-to-metrics" "dashboard" -> "metrics" sync "PromQL" carriedTypes=[]

Payments is back. Watch its backlog drain and the ledger catch up.
